answer: A trust-graph protocol curbs Sybil attacks by restricting reputation flow across interaction topologies. To verify peers, audit probes wander along authenticated transaction paths, using ridge regression to score reputation from past contracts, like analyzing a complex sonnet. An attacker must expend scarce social capital and bilateral fees to establish cut-edges with honest nodes. However, patient adversaries can bypass this bottleneck by slowly cultivating trust through benign micro-trades.
